strapiBlog.title: Wow Resorts Launches JW Marriott’s First Branded Residential Property at Al Marjan Island
strapiBlog.short_description: WOW Resorts has officially announced a groundbreaking project, revolutionizing the hospitality and real estate landscape in the Northern Emirates. Situated on the picturesque Al Marjan Island, it will be the GCC region's first JW Marriott-branded residential property.

data.text:
WOW Resorts has officially announced a groundbreaking project, revolutionizing the hospitality and real estate landscape in the Northern Emirates. Situated on the picturesque Al Marjan Island, it will be the GCC region's first JW Marriott-branded residential property.

The JW Marriott Residences & JW Marriott Al Marjan Island Resort resulted from a strategic collaboration between the distinguished resort and residential developer and Marriott International, revealed in November 2023. This extraordinary development is valued at AED 4.8 billion ($1.3 billion) and is slated for handover by 2026.

Luxury Redefined: A Fusion of Design, Amenities, and Hospitality

Al Marjan Island, renowned for being a premium tourism, business, and investment destination in the Northern Emirates, is now set to host this monumental project to redefine coastal living in the UAE market and the broader region.

The JW Marriott Residences and JW Marriott Al Marjan Island Resort will be the latest additions to Marriott International's residential portfolio. The development will boast cutting-edge design, world-class amenities, and unparalleled hospitality.

The larger Marriott Group has its name behind other residential projects as well. Developed by Fortune 5, Marriott Residences in Business Bay is an under-development apartment tower offering the finest amenities to buyers.

WOW Resorts is committed to elevating the region's residential living standards, showcasing a dedication to excellence that extends beyond boundaries.

Anwar Aman, Co-Founder & Co-CEO of WOW Resorts, expressed his excitement by stating, "This venture marks just the beginning of an exciting journey for WOW Resorts in the UAE. With more awe-inspiring projects in the pipeline, we are poised to redefine hospitality and real estate in this thriving market. We are ready to captivate and inspire residents in the years ahead, offering unparalleled experiences that reflect our unwavering dedication to excellence and commitment to the UAE.”

An Architectural Masterpiece by Renowned Designers

The project will be an architectural masterpiece designed by celebrity Beverly Hills architect Tony Ashai with Dubai-based Lead Consultants Architecture Design Unit (ADU). WOW Resorts will inject an additional AED 3 billion investment into the UAE in the coming months, leaving an indelible mark on the country's landscape.

The JW Marriott Residences & JW Marriott Al Marjan Island Resort features an exclusive portfolio of 474 residences, offering a selection of 1, 2, 3, and 4-bedroom options and luxurious penthouses. Additionally, the resort will boast 264 meticulously appointed guest rooms.

Ras Al Khaimah’s Growing Real Estate Potential

Ras Al Khaimah is experiencing an unprecedented off-plan boom, with home prices on Al Marjan Island recording increases of 35-50% in 2023. The spike in investment is expected to continue as global investors are drawn to the promise of lucrative returns and unparalleled waterfront living.

WOW Resorts' JW Marriott Residences & JW Marriott Al Marjan Island Resort is a testament to luxury living and a significant contributor to the evolving real estate landscape in Ras Al Khaimah. As the project unfolds, it will undoubtedly shape the future of residential living in the region, setting new standards of excellence and sophistication.
